{{Quote|A mainstay of the Gran diet, but perfectly suitable for anyone wanting a light meal. We toss fragrant goatgrass with Malastarian croutons, houjix cheese crumbles and three-eyed Kinyenian potatoes.|The description of Goatgrass salad at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
The '''three-eyed Kinyenian potato''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Potato/Legends|potato]] from<ref name="DaD" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] that was used in cooking. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] used the [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] as an [[Foodstuff/Legends|ingredient]] in its [[goatgrass salad]], along with [[Malastarian croutons]], crumbled [[houjix cheese]], [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-cut [[Plant/Legends|greens]] and toppings sourced from local [[VegSatellite]]s. [[Silvergrass|Goatgrass]] [[Salad/Legends|salad]] was considered a staple in the [[Diet/Legends|diet]] of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]],<ref name="DaD" /> a three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] species also from Kinyen.<ref name="NEGTAS" /> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of the diner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], considered the salad a light, delicious meal and served it with the potatoes in it as a lunch for 4.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Three-eyed Kinyenian potatoes were featured in the [[2009]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and released exclusively on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
